question: What ritual sequence must precede the recitation of the Sāvitrī mantra?
premises: The ṛṣi-nyāsa must be performed first
Recitation is done with the Sāvitrī
The recitation is prescribed as obligatory
inference: After performing the ṛṣi-nyāsa, one must perform the recitation of the Sāvitrī.
plain_english: Having performed the ṛṣi-nyāsa, the recitation of the Sāvitrī should be done.
